name: whole-deck-validation
body: The whole deck (config, filenames, frontmatter, sections, fields, bodies, links, images) is validated with uniform rules at every nesting level. Validation is fail-fast: it stops at the first error and reports exactly that one error. "First" is defined by a fixed, deterministic order: (1) kalide.yaml; (2) slide filenames (numbering, letters, label uniqueness); (3) each slide in number/letter order, and within a slide top-to-bottom by line (frontmatter, body, sections, fields); (4) inter-slide #label links last, since they need all labels known. Acceptance: the same invalid deck always yields the same single reported error, namely the earliest failure in this order.
